Fruit and Nut Cocoa Milk
By: Varsha Vipins
Published: Thursday, December 10, 2009 - 4:57pm

Ingredients




1/2 cup Milk
1/2 teaspoon Unsweetened Cocoa Powder
5 Dates chopped
2 tablespoons Dried Cranberries
6 Walnuts
1 tablespoon Honey
Grated Chocolate to top

Preparation

1 Boil the milk with sugar/honey. 2 Take a small amount of hot milk in glass and add the coco powder and stir briskly to mix. 3 Add the rest of the milk and mix well, avoiding lumps. 4 Keep aside a small amount and drown the walnuts. 5 Take a small amount of milk in the mixer and add the dates. 6 Run the mixer until dates are blended well. 7 Add the Craisins to it and run once,so that its not fully blended.  8 Add the walnuts with that soaked milk and run once ,so that its still coarse. 9 Add the rest of the milk and run until frothy on top. 10 Pour into a glass and garnish with grated dark chocolate/coco powder
